episodes.problem: ESMFold performance changed after migration to C550.
episodes.observation: Model tracing identified triangle attention and explicit bias and softmax work.

artifact_change.description: Introduce fused attention and LayerNorm, then bucket inputs and balance devices.

episodes.validation: A fixed 50-candidate workload took 1105.84 seconds in the bucketed baseline and 456.80 seconds in the single-device optimized path.
episodes.adoption: The execution path was used for three-seed and full870 pLDDT runs.
limits: The eight-device experiment also changed model-cache location.
Operator gains require fresh measurement on another runtime or device.

episodes.problem: An operator improvement can increase complete-model cost.
episodes.observation: Full-model experiments constrained the selected kernel and precision settings.

artifact_change.description: Retain complete-model ablations and an explicit selected-kernel policy.

episodes.validation: The accepted configuration disables triangle BMM repacking and uses IEEE FP32 attention.
episodes.adoption: Complete-model and numerical checks informed subsequent optimization choices.
limits: The rejected combination is specific to its measured environment.
The selected configuration alone does not quantify the rejected candidate performance.

episodes.problem: Similar aggregate scores can hide candidate-level numerical tails.
episodes.observation: Maximum differences across three seeds were 2.178, 3.466, and 2.949 points.

artifact_change.description: Report candidate-level distributions and fallback behavior while verifying slot reconstruction.

episodes.validation: A seed1 fallback brought 999 of 1000 candidates within 0.30 points.
episodes.adoption: Full Design acceptance subsequently checked slot coverage and numerical values.
limits: Strict candidate-level equivalence retains recorded boundaries across the three seeds.
